content_of_post_to_comment: I am 22 years old and I live in the countryside, where I hope to leave forever one day. I am not working at all right now; my father and I live on 500 euros a month. The nearest city, where the jobs are, is a 10-minute drive away, but don't imagine anything major—salaries are around 900 euros a month. I have a vocational high school (EPAL) diploma, I am 22, and I have 400 euros in the bank. No one works in this house. I hope that somehow, one day, I can go to university to study and build myself up. Even starting in the trades wouldn't bother me—I just want to kickstart my career. In previous years, I didn't go out of the house much, so truth be told, I don't have any friends right now. What would you advise me to do? I want so badly to evolve, to learn something, and to finally progress as a human being! I have so many dreams and I believe in myself, but I do so much negative self-talk sometimes because my situation feels so sad with everything happening in my life. I feel trapped—or at least that's how it feels—and I just don't want to waste any more years of my life. What would you advise me? I'm seeing guys here on Reddit having 1 million dollar portfolio in investments at 20 years old while attending college? How the fk is that possible why i am like this??
comment: The fact that you’re comparing yourself to people claiming million-dollar portfolios at 20 is probably making things feel worse than they are. A lot of those stories leave out family support, luck, location, or years of hidden work. You’re 22, have a diploma, some savings, and a clear desire to change your situation. Pick one practical step first—finding work, learning a trade, or exploring study options—and build from there.
